issues.title: Missing 13 Core Leaf Files
issues.why: The spec references 13 critical files (01-13) for principles, variables, and component logic, but they are not provided in the context. A mediocre AI cannot implement the 'Variable-First' architecture without the variable registry (02) or component patterns (07-11).
issues.fix: Provide the content for files 01-13 in the prompt context.

issues.title: Missing CSS/Tailwind Fixtures
issues.why: While the spec defines the architecture, it lacks the actual 'index.css' and 'tailwind.config.ts' content. An AI coder must guess the exact HSL values and Tailwind extension keys, leading to 0% confidence in visual parity.
issues.fix: Include the full source code for src/index.css and tailwind.config.ts as examples.

issues.title: Vague Error Handling for Token API
issues.why: The OpenAPI spec (Phase 58) defines a 404 for /tokens/{name} but doesn't specify the error response schema or how to handle invalid 'category' queries in the list endpoint.
issues.fix: Add a standard Error schema to the OpenAPI components and reference it in 400/404 responses.
